gen-mystery-quest-gf-stack-sans-notch: Mystery Quest has a bookish, nostalgic lilt, with open jaws on every curve. Its diagonals run low, while Stack Sans Notch, a plain sans, draws rod-stock stems and wide curves you can see right into.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, its lowercase standing tall in every word. And Bricolage Grotesque, with a wide-mouthed c and big x-height, gives the pair a crisp, clean front door.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-fs-literata: Literata reads sophisticated and bookish, its curves ending in wide, unclosed mouths and its thin lines staying sturdy. Soft shifts, never stark.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab reads dignified, with capitals and lowercase standing almost shoulder to shoulder in a text serif. Bricolage Grotesque feels crisp beside it.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-esteban: Esteban reads refined and classic, its lowercase looking oversized beside its capitals and its e never squeezed shut. And its thin strokes are barely slimmer than the stems, a soft counterpart to Bricolage Grotesque.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-faustina: A big x-height with tight ascender room gives Bricolage Grotesque its compact, confident look. Faustina follows in a text serif with authoritative bowls that thin gracefully, like a lightly pressed brush.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-halant: Halant reads authoritative and traditional, with towering lowercase. Bricolage Grotesque handles the clean, compact headline work, while the text serif Halant carries a faint thick-thin shift with outward-pointing terminals.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-marcellus-sc: Bricolage Grotesque opens its c wide and packs a big x-height under tight ascenders. Marcellus SC, a classic serif, adds gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals, so the two feel dignified beside a plainspoken partner.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-montagu-slab: Traditional and refined, Montagu Slab sets sturdy downstrokes against slender turns in a serif with a sizable x-height. And Bricolage Grotesque earns its keep up top, big and short, with its wide-mouthed c.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-noto-serif-he: Refined, traditional, tall in the lowercase. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a text serif, keeps its thinnest strokes sturdy while Bricolage Grotesque handles the big, clean statements with its wide-mouthed c.
